title: N-sample moving average (ring buffer)
task: Smooth a noisy analog reading with an N-sample moving average using a ring buffer.

title: Digital input debounce with a TON timer
task: Debounce a noisy digital input using a TON on-delay timer; accept a change only after it is stable.

title: Motor seal-in (latch) + running lamp
task: Start/stop seal-in latch to run a conveyor motor with a running lamp; multi-rung scan order.

title: Station-ready permissive + XOR jam lamp
task: Compute a station cycle-ready permissive from sensors/flags and an XOR-based jam lamp.

title: Conveyor poll — unbounded WHILE TRUE loop (safety-lint NEGATIVE)
task: A condition-driven loop whose condition never turns false and whose body has no EXIT/RETURN, driving a motor output.

title: Pick-and-place (move_linear / grip / release)
task: Author an IR pick-and-place for a collaborative robot: approach, descend, grip, traverse, place, release.

title: Palletize / stack loop (loop + counter + handshake)
task: Author an IR palletize loop repeating a pick/place cycle N times, counting placed parts with a digital handshake.

title: Linear move + gripper (transpiler-target dialect)
task: URScript with movel linear moves and gripper open/close, in the exact style the IR->URScript transpiler emits.

title: Single-axis absolute move (MOVEABS)
task: Configure axis 0 and perform one absolute positioning move, waiting for the axis to stop.

title: FOR/NEXT feeder index loop
task: Index a feeder N relative steps with a dwell between each, using a FOR/NEXT loop.

title: MELSEC device/recipe parameter table
task: Create a MELSEC device/recipe table: D-register setpoints and M-bit mode flags for a product recipe.

title: Techman TMflow pick-and-place job-list
task: Techman job-list with taught POINTs: home, pick at A, place at B with a gripper dwell, return home.

title: Wide-reach job — POINT far outside the workspace envelope (safety-lint NEGATIVE)
task: A job-list that reaches a POINT far outside a conservative workspace envelope, then returns to a normal drop point.

title: Fanuc KAREL / TP (Tier B placeholder — few-shot RAG examples)
task: RAG-first; no sim substrate yet. Few-shot GENERATION examples pending Fanuc manual ingestion (P1). See karel/bounded-index-loop.ls + unbounded-index-loop.ls for the (separate) safety-linter golden pair.

title: Bounded index loop — conditional back-jump (safety-lint POSITIVE)
task: Index 3 parts, counting down in a register, with a conditionally-guarded back-jump to the loop label.

title: Unbounded index loop — unconditional back-jump (safety-lint NEGATIVE)
task: Same index pattern, but the back-jump lost its IF guard, so the loop never reaches its exit label.

title: ABB RAPID (Tier B placeholder — few-shot RAG examples)
task: RAG-first; no sim substrate yet. Few-shot GENERATION examples pending ABB manual ingestion (P1). See rapid/palletize-loop.mod + fast-traverse.mod for the (separate) safety-linter golden pair.

title: Bounded FOR palletize loop, in-envelope speeds (safety-lint POSITIVE)
task: Palletize 4 parts with a bounded FOR loop at moderate speeds (v100/v150).

title: Excessive-speed traverse — v1500 (safety-lint NEGATIVE)
task: MoveL to a far point using the predefined ABB speeddata v1500 (1500 mm/s), far above a conservative ceiling.

title: Mitsubishi MELFA-BASIC V/VI (Tier B placeholder — few-shot RAG examples)
task: RAG-first; no sim substrate yet. Few-shot GENERATION examples pending Mitsubishi MELFA manual ingestion (P1). Not the same as mitsubishi-engineering (PLC). See melfa/gated-pick-place.prg + bare-pick-place.prg for the (separate) safety-linter golden pair.

title: Pick-place gated by a digital input (safety-lint POSITIVE)
task: A pick-place motion + output block that only runs inside IF M_IN(1)=1 THEN … ENDIF.

title: Unguarded pick-place — no conditional anywhere (safety-lint NEGATIVE)
task: The same pick-place sequence with the IF/ENDIF guard removed — motion + output run unconditionally.

title: Delta robot DRAS / DIAStudio (Tier B placeholder — few-shot RAG examples)
task: RAG-first; no sim substrate yet. Few-shot GENERATION examples pending Delta manual ingestion (P1). See delta-robot/gated-transfer.drl + bare-transfer.drl for the (separate) safety-linter golden pair.

title: Transfer gated by a digital input (safety-lint POSITIVE)
task: A transfer motion + output block that only runs inside IF DI(1)=1 THEN … END IF.

title: Unguarded transfer — no conditional anywhere (safety-lint NEGATIVE)
task: The same transfer sequence with the IF/END IF guard removed — motion + output run unconditionally.
